verses.original: וְשָׁ֨ם נִקְרָ֜א אִ֣ישׁ בְּלִיַּ֗עַל וּשְׁמ֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִ֖י אִ֣ישׁ יְמִינִ֑י וַיִּתְקַ֣ע בַּשֹּׁפָ֗ר וַ֠יֹּאמֶר אֵֽין־ לָ֨נוּ חֵ֜לֶק בְּדָוִ֗ד וְלֹ֤א נַֽחֲלָה־ לָ֙נוּ֙ בְּבֶן־ יִשַׁ֔י אִ֥ישׁ לְאֹהָלָ֖יו יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šām niq·rā ’îš bə·lî·ya·‘al ū·šə·mōw še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî ’îš yə·mî·nî way·yiṯ·qa‘ baš·šō·p̄ār way·yō·mer ’ên- lā·nū ḥê·leq bə·ḏā·wiḏ wə·lō na·ḥă·lāh- lā·nū bə·ḇen- yi·šay ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now a worthless man named Sheba son of Bichri a Benjamite happened to be there and he blew the ram’s horn and shouted We have no . . . share in David no inheritance in Jesse’s son Every man to his tent O Israel
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO se achou ali por acaso um homem de Belial, cujo nome era Seba, filho de Bicri, homem de Benjamim, o qual tocou a buzina, e disse: Não temos parte em Davi, nem herança no filho de Jessé; cada um às suas tendas, ó Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַל כָּל־ אִ֤ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֣בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִ֑י וְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ דָּבְק֣וּ בְמַלְכָּ֔ם מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וְעַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl mê·’a·ḥă·rê ḏā·wiḏ ’a·ḥă·rê še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî wə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh dā·ḇə·qū ḇə·mal·kām min- hay·yar·dên wə·‘aḏ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So all the men of Israel deserted . . . David to follow Sheba son of Bichri But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Então todos os homens de Israel se separaram de Davi, e seguiram Seba, filho de Bicri; porém os homens de Judá se uniram ao seu rei desde o Jordão até Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א דָוִ֣ד אֶל־ בֵּיתוֹ֮ יְרֽוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיִּקַּ֣ח הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת עֶֽשֶׂר־ נָשִׁ֣ים׀ פִּלַגְשִׁ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִנִּיחַ֩ לִשְׁמֹ֨ר הַבַּ֜יִת וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֤ם בֵּית־ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ וַֽיְכַלְכְּלֵ֔ם וַאֲלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹא־ בָ֑א וַתִּהְיֶ֧ינָה צְרֻר֛וֹת עַד־ י֥וֹם מֻתָ֖ן אַלְמְנ֥וּת חַיּֽוּת׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḏā·wiḏ ’el- bê·ṯōw yə·rū·šā·lim way·yiq·qaḥ ham·me·leḵ ’êṯ ‘e·śer- nā·šîm pi·laḡ·šîm ’ă·šer hin·nî·aḥ liš·mōr hab·ba·yiṯ way·yit·tə·nêm bêṯ- miš·me·reṯ way·ḵal·kə·lêm wa·’ă·lê·hem lō- ḇā wat·tih·ye·nāh ṣə·ru·rō·wṯ ‘aḏ- yō·wm mu·ṯān ’al·mə·nūṯ ḥay·yūṯ
verses.literal: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem he took the ten . . . concubines he had left to take care of the palace and he placed them in a house under guard He provided for them but he no longer slept with them They were confined until the day of their death living as widows
verses.literalPt: Vindo, pois, Davi para sua casa, em Jerusalém, tomou o rei as dez mulheres, suas concubinas, que deixara para guardarem a casa, e as pôs numa casa sob guarda, e as sustentava; porém não as possuiu; e estiveram encerradas até ao dia da sua morte, vivendo como viúvas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ אֶל־ עֲמָשָׂ֔א הַזְעֶק־ לִ֥י אֶת־ אִישׁ־ יְהוּדָ֖ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וְאַתָּ֖ה פֹּ֥ה עֲמֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ham·me·leḵ ’el- ‘ă·mā·śā haz·‘eq- lî ’eṯ- ’îš- yə·hū·ḏāh šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm wə·’at·tāh pōh ‘ă·mōḏ
verses.literal: Then the king said to Amasa Summon the men of Judah to come to me within three days and be here . . . yourself
verses.literalPt: Disse mais o rei a Amasa: Convoca-me os homens de Judá para o terceiro dia; e tu então apresenta-te aqui.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ עֲמָשָׂ֖א לְהַזְעִ֣יק אֶת־ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיֵּיחַר מִן־ הַמּוֹעֵ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְעָדֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ‘ă·mā·śā lə·haz·‘îq ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh way·yē·ḥar min- ham·mō·w·‘êḏ ’ă·šer yə·‘ā·ḏōw
verses.literal: So Amasa went to summon Judah but he took longer than the time allotted him
verses.literalPt: E foi Amasa para convocar a Judá; porém demorou-se além do tempo que lhe tinha sido designado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ אֶל־ אֲבִישַׁ֔י עַתָּ֗ה יֵ֧רַֽע לָ֛נוּ שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִ֖י מִן־ אַבְשָׁל֑וֹם אַ֠תָּה קַ֞ח אֶת־ עַבְדֵ֤י אֲדֹנֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְדֹ֣ף אַחֲרָ֔יו פֶּן־ מָ֥צָא ל֛וֹ עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻר֖וֹת וְהִצִּ֥יל עֵינֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’el- ’ă·ḇî·šay ‘at·tāh yê·ra‘ lā·nū še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî min- ’aḇ·šā·lō·wm ’at·tāh qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā ū·rə·ḏōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rāw pen- mā·ṣā lōw ‘ā·rîm bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ wə·hiṣ·ṣîl ‘ê·nê·nū
verses.literal: And David said to Abishai Now Sheba the son of Bichri will do us more harm . . . than Absalom . . . Take your lord’s servants and pursue him . . . or he will find . . . fortified cities and elude us
verses.literalPt: Então disse Davi a Abisai: Mais mal agora nos fará Seba, o filho de Bicri, do que Absalão; por isso toma tu os servos de teu senhor, e persegue-o, para que não ache para si cidades fortes; e escape dos nossos olhos.

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֤וּ אַֽחֲרָיו֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב וְהַכְּרֵתִ֥י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֖י וְכָל־ הַגִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַיֵּֽצְאוּ֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū ’a·ḥă·rāw ’an·šê yō·w·’āḇ wə·hak·kə·rê·ṯî wə·hap·pə·lê·ṯî wə·ḵāl hag·gib·bō·rîm way·yê·ṣə·’ū mî·rū·šā·lim lir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî
verses.literal: So Joab’s men - along with the Cherethites the Pelethites and all the mighty men marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit . . . of Sheba son of Bichri
verses.literalPt: Então saíram atrás dele os homens de Joabe, e os quereteus, e os peleteus, e todos os valentes; estes saíram de Jerusalém para irem atrás de Seba, filho de Bicri.

verses.original: הֵ֗ם עִם־ הָאֶ֤בֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּגִבְע֔וֹן וַעֲמָשָׂ֖א בָּ֣א לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְיוֹאָ֞ב חָג֣וּר׀ מִדּ֣וֹ לְבֻשׁ֗וּ וְעָלוֹ חֲג֥וֹר חֶ֙רֶב֙ מְצֻמֶּ֤דֶת עַל־ מָתְנָיו֙ בְּתַעְרָ֔הּ וְה֥וּא יָצָ֖א וַתִּפֹּֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: hêm ‘im- hā·’e·ḇen hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh ’ă·šer bə·ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn wa·‘ă·mā·śā bā lip̄·nê·hem wə·yō·w·’āḇ ḥā·ḡūr mid·dōw lə·ḇu·šū wə·ʿå̄·lō ḥă·ḡō·wr ḥe·reḇ mə·ṣum·me·ḏeṯ ‘al- mā·ṯə·nāw bə·ṯa‘·rāh wə·hū yā·ṣā wat·tip·pōl
verses.literal: And while they were at the great stone in Gibeon Amasa joined them Now Joab was dressed in military attire . . . with a dagger strapped to his belt . . . . . . And as he stepped forward he slipped the dagger from its sheath
verses.literalPt: Chegando eles, pois, à pedra grande, que está junto a Gibeom, Amasa veio diante deles; e estava Joabe cingido da sua roupa que vestira, e sobre ela um cinto, ao qual estava presa a espada a seus lombos, na sua bainha; e, adiantando-se ele, lhe caiu a espada.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יוֹאָב֙ לַעֲמָשָׂ֔א הֲשָׁל֥וֹם אַתָּ֖ה אָחִ֑י וַתֹּ֜חֶז יַד־ יְמִ֥ין יוֹאָ֛ב בִּזְקַ֥ן עֲמָשָׂ֖א לִנְשָׁק־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yō·w·’āḇ la·‘ă·mā·śā hă·šā·lō·wm ’at·tāh ’ā·ḥî wat·tō·ḥez yaḏ- yə·mîn yō·w·’āḇ biz·qan ‘ă·mā·śā lin·šāq- lōw
verses.literal: Are you well my brother Joab asked Amasa And with his right hand Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard to kiss him
verses.literalPt: E disse Joabe a Amasa: Vai bem, meu irmão? E Joabe, com a mão direita, pegou da barba de Amasa, para o beijar.

verses.original: וַעֲמָשָׂ֨א לֹֽא־ נִשְׁמַ֜ר בַּחֶ֣רֶב׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיַד־ יוֹאָ֗ב וַיַּכֵּהוּ֩ בָ֨הּ אֶל־ הַחֹ֜מֶשׁ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ מֵעָ֥יו אַ֛רְצָה וְלֹא־ שָׁ֥נָה ל֖וֹ וַיָּמֹ֑תס וְיוֹאָב֙ וַאֲבִישַׁ֣י אָחִ֔יו רָדַ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·mā·śā lō- niš·mar ba·ḥe·reḇ ’ă·šer bə·yaḏ- yō·w·’āḇ way·yak·kê·hū ḇāh ’el- ha·ḥō·meš way·yiš·pōḵ mê·‘āw ’ar·ṣāh wə·lō- šā·nāh lōw way·yå̄·mō·ṯs wə·yō·w·’āḇ wa·’ă·ḇî·šay ’ā·ḥîw rā·ḏap̄ ’a·ḥă·rê še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî
verses.literal: Amasa was not on guard against the dagger in Joab’s hand and Joab stabbed him in the stomach and spilled out his intestines . . . on the ground And Joab did not need to strike him again . . . for Amasa was dead Then Joab and his brother Abishai pursued . . . Sheba son of Bichri
verses.literalPt: E Amasa não se resguardou da espada que estava na mão de Joabe, de sorte que este o feriu com ela na quinta costela, e lhe derramou por terra as entranhas, e não o feriu segunda vez, e morreu; então Joabe e Abisai, seu irmão, foram atrás de Seba, filho de Bicri.

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ עָמַ֣ד עָלָ֔יו מִֽנַּעֲרֵ֖י יוֹאָ֑ב וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מִי֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָפֵ֧ץ בְּיוֹאָ֛ב וּמִ֥י אֲשֶׁר־ לְדָוִ֖ד אַחֲרֵ֥י יוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’îš ‘ā·maḏ ‘ā·lāw min·na·‘ă·rê yō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer mî ’ă·šer ḥā·p̄êṣ bə·yō·w·’āḇ ū·mî ’ă·šer- lə·ḏā·wiḏ ’a·ḥă·rê yō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: One of Joab’s young men stood near Amasa and said Whoever favors Joab and whoever is for David let him follow Joab
verses.literalPt: Mas um dentre os homens de Joabe parou junto a ele, e disse: Quem há que queira bem a Joabe, e quem seja por Davi, siga Joabe.

verses.original: וַעֲמָשָׂ֛א מִתְגֹּלֵ֥ל בַּדָּ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הַֽמְסִּלָּ֑ה וַיַּ֨רְא הָאִ֜ישׁ כִּֽי־ עָמַ֣ד כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם וַיַּסֵּב֩ אֶת־ עֲמָשָׂ֨א מִן־ הַֽמְסִלָּ֤ה הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וַיַּשְׁלֵ֤ךְ עָלָיו֙ בֶּ֔גֶד כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאָ֔ה כָּל־ הַבָּ֥א עָלָ֖יו וְעָמָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·mā·śā miṯ·gō·lêl bad·dām bə·ṯō·wḵ ham·mə·sil·lāh way·yar hā·’îš kî- ‘ā·maḏ kāl- hā·‘ām way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·śā min- ham·sil·lāh haś·śā·ḏeh way·yaš·lêḵ ‘ā·lāw be·ḡeḏ ka·’ă·šer rā·’āh kāl- hab·bā ‘ā·lāw wə·‘ā·māḏ
verses.literal: But Amasa wallowed in his blood in the middle of the road and when the man saw that all the troops were stopping there he dragged the body off the road into a field and threw a garment over it - -
verses.literalPt: E Amasa estava envolto no seu sangue no meio do caminho; e, vendo aquele homem, que todo o povo parava, removeu a Amasa do caminho para o campo, e lançou sobre ele um manto; porque via que todo aquele que chegava a ele parava.

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹגָ֖ה מִן־ הַֽמְסִלָּ֑ה עָבַ֤ר כָּל־ אִישׁ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יוֹאָ֔ב לִרְדֹּ֕ף אַחֲרֵ֖י שֶׁ֥בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer hō·ḡāh min- ham·sil·lāh ‘ā·ḇar kāl- ’îš ’a·ḥă·rê yō·w·’āḇ lir·dōp̄ ’a·ḥă·rê še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî
verses.literal: As soon as Amasa’s body was removed from the road all the men went on with Joab to pursue . . . Sheba son of Bichri
verses.literalPt: E, como estava removido do caminho, todos os homens seguiram a Joabe, para perseguirem a Seba, filho de Bicri.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֞ר בְּכָל־ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אָבֵ֛לָה וּבֵ֥ית מַעֲכָ֖ה וְכָל־ הַבֵּרִ֑יםס וַיִּקָּלְהוּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַף־ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr bə·ḵāl šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl ’ā·ḇê·lāh ū·ḇêṯ ma·‘ă·ḵāh wə·ḵāl hab·bē·rī·ms way·yiq·qå̄·lə·hū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ap̄- ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Sheba passed through all the tribes of Israel to Abel-beth-maacah . . . . . . and through the entire region of the Berites who gathered together and followed . . . him
verses.literalPt: E ele passou por todas as tribos de Israel até Abel, e Bete-Maaca e a todos os beritas; e ajuntaram-se, e também o seguiram.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ וַיָּצֻ֣רוּ עָלָ֗יו בְּאָבֵ֙לָה֙ בֵּ֣ית הַֽמַּעֲכָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁפְּכ֤וּ סֹֽלְלָה֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֔יר וַֽתַּעֲמֹ֖ד בַּחֵ֑ל וְכָל־ הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶת־ יוֹאָ֔ב מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ם לְהַפִּ֥יל הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū way·yā·ṣu·rū ‘ā·lāw bə·’ā·ḇê·lāh bêṯ ham·ma·‘ă·ḵāh way·yiš·pə·ḵū sō·lə·lāh ’el- hā·‘îr wat·ta·‘ă·mōḏ ba·ḥêl wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’eṯ- yō·w·’āḇ maš·ḥî·ṯim lə·hap·pîl ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: And Joab’s troops came and besieged Sheba in Abel-beth-maacah . . . . . . and built a siege ramp . . . against the outer rampart of the city . . . As all the troops with Joab were battering the wall to topple it
verses.literalPt: E vieram, e o cercaram em Abel de Bete-Maaca, e levantaram uma barragem contra a cidade, e isto colocado na trincheira; e todo o povo que estava com Joabe batia no muro, para derrubá-lo.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרָ֛א אִשָּׁ֥ה חֲכָמָ֖ה מִן־ הָעִ֑יר שִׁמְע֤וּ שִׁמְעוּ֙ אִמְרוּ־ נָ֣א אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב קְרַ֣ב עַד־ הֵ֔נָּה וַאֲדַבְּרָ֖ה אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rā ’iš·šāh ḥă·ḵā·māh min- hā·‘îr šim·‘ū šim·‘ū ’im·rū- nā ’el- yō·w·’āḇ qə·raḇ ‘aḏ- hên·nāh wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: a wise woman called out from the city Listen Listen Please tell Joab to come . . . here so that I may speak with him
verses.literalPt: Então uma mulher sábia gritou de dentro da cidade: Ouvi, ouvi, peço-vos que digais a Joabe: Chega-te aqui, para que eu te fale.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יהָ וַתֹּ֧אמֶר הָאִשָּׁ֛ה הַאַתָּ֥ה יוֹאָ֖ב וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָ֑נִי וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ שְׁמַע֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר שֹׁמֵ֥עַ אָנֹֽכִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·raḇ ’ê·le·hā wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ha·’at·tāh yō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mer ’ā·nî wat·tō·mer lōw šə·ma‘ diḇ·rê ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā way·yō·mer šō·mê·a‘ ’ā·nō·ḵî
verses.literal: When he had come near to her the woman asked Are you Joab I am he replied Listen to the words of your servant she said I am listening he answered
verses.literalPt: Chegando-se a ela, a mulher lhe disse: Tu és Joabe? E disse ele: Eu sou. E ela lhe disse: Ouve as palavras da tua serva. E disse ele: Ouço.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֖אמֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֨ר יְדַבְּר֤וּ בָרִֽאשֹׁנָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר שָׁאֹ֧ל יְשָׁאֲל֛וּ בְּאָבֵ֖ל וְכֵ֥ן הֵתַֽמּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer lê·mōr dab·bêr yə·ḏab·bə·rū ḇā·ri·šō·nāh lê·mōr šā·’ōl yə·šā·’ă·lū bə·’ā·ḇêl wə·ḵên hê·ṯam·mū
verses.literal: Then the woman said . . . Long ago . . . they used to say . . . Seek counsel . . . at Abel and that is how disputes were settled
verses.literalPt: Então falou ela, dizendo: Antigamente costumava-se dizer: Certamente pediram conselho a Abel; e assim resolveram.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֕י שְׁלֻמֵ֖י אֱמוּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהָמִ֨ית עִ֤יר וְאֵם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָ֥מָּה תְבַלַּ֖ע נַחֲלַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî šə·lu·mê ’ĕ·mū·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’at·tāh mə·ḇaq·qêš lə·hā·mîṯ ‘îr wə·’êm bə·yiś·rā·’êl lām·māh ṯə·ḇal·la‘ na·ḥă·laṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: I am among the peaceable and faithful in Israel but you are trying to destroy a city that is a mother in Israel Why would you swallow up the LORD’s inheritance
verses.literalPt: Sou eu uma das pacíficas e das fiéis em Israel; e tu procuras matar uma cidade que é mãe em Israel; por que, pois, devorarias a herança do SENHOR?

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן יוֹאָ֖ב וַיֹּאמַ֑ר חָלִ֤ילָה חָלִ֙ילָה֙ לִ֔י אִם־ אֲבַלַּ֖ע וְאִם־ אַשְׁחִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an yō·w·’āḇ way·yō·mar ḥā·lî·lāh ḥā·lî·lāh lî ’im- ’ă·ḇal·la‘ wə·’im- ’aš·ḥîṯ
verses.literal: Far be it Joab declared Far be it from me to swallow up or destroy
verses.literalPt: Então respondeu Joabe, e disse: Longe, longe de mim que eu tal faça, que eu devore ou arruíne!

verses.original: לֹא־ כֵ֣ן הַדָּבָ֗ר כִּ֡י אִישׁ֩ מֵהַ֨ר אֶפְרַ֜יִם שֶׁ֧בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִ֣י שְׁמ֗וֹ נָשָׂ֤א יָדוֹ֙ בַּמֶּ֣לֶךְ בְּדָוִ֔ד תְּנֽוּ־ אֹת֣וֹ לְבַדּ֔וֹ וְאֵלְכָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ל הָעִ֑יר וַתֹּ֤אמֶר הָֽאִשָּׁה֙ אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב הִנֵּ֥ה רֹאשׁ֛וֹ מֻשְׁלָ֥ךְ אֵלֶ֖יךָ בְּעַ֥ד הַחוֹמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ḵên had·dā·ḇār kî ’îš mê·har ’ep̄·ra·yim še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî šə·mōw nā·śā yā·ḏōw bam·me·leḵ bə·ḏā·wiḏ tə·nū- ’ō·ṯōw lə·ḇad·dōw wə·’ê·lə·ḵāh mê·‘al hā·‘îr wat·tō·mer hā·’iš·šāh ’el- yō·w·’āḇ hin·nêh rō·šōw muš·lāḵ ’ê·le·ḵā bə·‘aḏ ha·ḥō·w·māh
verses.literal: That is not the case But a man named Sheba son of Bichri from the hill country of Ephraim has lifted up his hand against the king against David Deliver him alone and I will depart from the city Look the woman replied - his head will be thrown to you over the wall
verses.literalPt: A coisa não é assim; porém um só homem do monte de Efraim, cujo nome é Seba, filho de Bicri, levantou a mão contra o rei, contra Davi; entregai-me só este, e retirar-me-ei da cidade. Então disse a mulher a Joabe: Eis que te será lançada a sua cabeça pelo muro.

verses.original: וַתָּבוֹא֩ הָאִשָּׁ֨ה אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֜ם בְּחָכְמָתָ֗הּ וַֽיִּכְרְת֞וּ אֶת־ רֹ֨אשׁ שֶׁ֤בַע בֶּן־ בִּכְרִי֙ וַיַּשְׁלִ֣כוּ אֶל־ יוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּתְקַע֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֔ר וַיָּפֻ֥צוּ מֵֽעַל־ הָעִ֖יר אִ֣ישׁ לְאֹהָלָ֑יו וְיוֹאָ֛ב שָׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·w hā·’iš·šāh ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯāh way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū ’eṯ- rōš še·ḇa‘ ben- biḵ·rî way·yaš·li·ḵū ’el- yō·w·’āḇ way·yiṯ·qa‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār way·yā·p̄u·ṣū mê·‘al- hā·‘îr ’îš lə·’ō·hā·lāw wə·yō·w·’āḇ šāḇ yə·rū·šā·lim ’el- ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Then the woman went to all the people with her wise counsel and they cut off the head of Sheba son of Bichri and threw it to Joab So he blew the ram’s horn and his men dispersed from the city each to his own home And Joab returned to the king in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: E a mulher, na sua sabedoria, foi a todo o povo, e cortaram a cabeça de Seba, filho de Bicri, e a lançaram a Joabe; então este tocou a buzina, e se retiraram da cidade, cada um para a sua tenda, e Joabe voltou a Jerusalém, ao rei.

verses.original: וְיוֹאָ֕ב אֶ֥ל כָּל־ הַצָּבָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּבְנָיָה֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע עַל־ הַכְּרִי וְעַל־ הַפְּלֵתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·’āḇ ’el kāl- haṣ·ṣā·ḇā yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇə·nā·yāh ben- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ‘al- hak·kə·rī wə·‘al- hap·pə·lê·ṯî
verses.literal: Now Joab was over the whole army of Israel Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites
verses.literalPt: E Joabe estava sobre todo o exército de Israel; e Benaia, filho de Joiada, sobre os quereteus e sobre os peleteus;

verses.original: וַאֲדֹרָ֖ם עַל־ הַמַּ֑ס וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד הַמַּזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḏō·rām ‘al- ham·mas wî·hō·wō·šā·p̄āṭ ben- ’ă·ḥî·lūḏ ham·maz·kîr
verses.literal: Adoram was in charge of the forced labor Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder
verses.literalPt: E Adorão sobre os tributos; e Jeosafá, filho de Ailude, era o cronista;

verses.original: וְשֵׁיָא סֹפֵ֑ר וְצָד֥וֹק וְאֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šē·yå̄ sō·p̄êr wə·ṣā·ḏō·wq wə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: Sheva was the scribe Zadok and Abiathar were priests
verses.literalPt: E Seva, o escrivão; e Zadoque e Abiatar, os sacerdotes;

verses.original: וְגַ֗ם עִירָא֙ הַיָּ֣אִרִ֔י הָיָ֥ה כֹהֵ֖ן לְדָוִֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ‘î·rā hay·yā·’i·rî hā·yāh ḵō·hên lə·ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: and Ira the Jairite was David’s priest
verses.literalPt: E também Ira, o jairita, era o oficial-mor de Davi.
